newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 28.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Carmaker Renault's announcement is to close down a Belgian plant, cutting some 3,100 jobs, raises protest in Belgium.

-- Government to bail out insurer GAN with an 11-billion-franc recapitalisation, and guarantee of property-related risks of up to nine billion, plans to privatise in 1997. GAN lost 5 billion francs in 1996.
-- BNP to launch pension funds for its employees.
-- PSA Peugeot Citroen to invest some 3.2 billion francs to develop a new generation of engines near Metz.
-- Renault to reshuffle European production, close down Belgian plant to cut costs. Analysts expect the carmaker to post 1996 losses estimated at four to five billion francs.
